reason: Share standard PBR surface sampling between Forward and Deferred, including vertex RGBA and matching alpha coverage in depth, shadow, normal, motion and outline passes; preserve material uniform ABI.
releaseQualification: pending G07 package and API review

vertexColors.scope: private linear normalized RGBA; no importer/editor API

opaqueProxy: G1 roughness=-1 marks extended opaque PBR; resolve writes shared scene depth; opaque full Forward samples G1 via otherwise unused pass binding 11, preserving the 16-texture layout. Transparent/transmission retain scene color. Original sorted item offsets and coplanar winner mask are preserved.

lightingAo.semantics: screen-space visibility modulates ambient and environment terms, preserving direct lighting, emission and transmitted scene radiance
lightingAo.bufferLayout: u32 width,height,rowStrideWords,layoutVersion=2; padded r16float pixels at byte 256, two values per u32; neutral width=0

beforePackedAo.bufferLayout: u32 width,height,rowStrideWords,reserved; rgba16float pixels at byte 256; neutral width=0
